entities.name: Braids
entities.description: A powerful, mad dementia caster for the Cabal who was later resurrected as a nightmare during the second Phyrexian Invasion.

entities.name: Cabal
entities.description: The black-aligned organization of Otaria that Braids serves.

entities.name: Laquatus
entities.description: A merman who bargains with Braids for the Mirari and is later left alone in Krosa.

entities.name: Mirari
entities.description: A powerful orb Braids pocketed and returned to the First.

entities.name: Aboshan
entities.description: Mer Empire emperor who used the Mirari to sink a third of Otaria and killed himself.

entities.name: Mer Empire
entities.description: Empire whose capital vaults Braids' team catalogued.

entities.name: The First
entities.description: A Cabal leader to whom Braids returned the Mirari.

entities.name: Skellum
entities.description: Pit-fighter who fought alongside Braids and died.

entities.name: Patriarch
entities.description: Cabal leader exiled by Chainer, whom Braids served as second-in-command before killing the Cabal Patriarch.

entities.name: Chainer
entities.description: The one who exiled the Patriarch and created five serpent assassins.

entities.name: Kuberr
entities.description: A figure whose visions told Braids to go south to Aphetto and who is later born.

entities.name: Aphetto
entities.description: Place to which Braids went to prepare for the Patriarch.

entities.name: Kamahl
entities.description: Barbarian hunted by Braids for the Mirari.

entities.name: Balthor
entities.description: Companion of Kamahl, zombified by Braids.

entities.name: Leer
entities.description: Cabal member killed by Balthor.

entities.name: Krosa
entities.description: Forest where the Order and Cabal armies fought.

entities.name: Traybor
entities.description: Dementia caster left in charge of the Cabal army.

entities.name: Commander Eesha
entities.description: Cabal commander who helps reveal Laquatus's treachery.

entities.name: Seton
entities.description: Centaur killed by Braids.

entities.name: Jeska
entities.description: Captive kidnapped by Braids and turned into Phage.

entities.name: Akroma
entities.description: Angel who took Braids to access Cabal secrets.

entities.name: Ixidor
entities.description: Figure Kamahl and the First fought; Braids claimed him as her new god.

entities.name: Stonebrow
entities.description: Steward of Topos whom Braids served.

entities.name: Karona
entities.description: Figure of Karona's War, over whom many Otarians fanaticized.

entities.name: Shanna Sisay
entities.description: Ally of Braids against her shard-self.

entities.name: Tiana
entities.description: Ally of Braids against her shard-self.

entities.name: Rafwyn Capashen
entities.description: Ally of Braids against her shard-self.

entities.name: Weatherlight
entities.description: Ship whose compleation was witnessed.

entities.name: Second Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: Invasion during which Braids escaped her dementia space.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: Plane where Braids serves the Cabal.

events.summary: Braids leads Cabalists to the Mer Empire capital and makes a deal with Laquatus to find the Mirari; Aboshan finds it first and dies.
events.quote: she made a deal with Laquatus to find the Mirari for him

events.summary: Braids pockets the Mirari, immune to its lure, and returns it to the First.
events.quote: she merely pocketed it and made her way back to Cabal City

events.summary: Braids fights in a rigged pit fight with Skellum and is knocked unconscious but survives.
events.quote: she escaped the fight with her life intact

events.summary: Visions of Kuberr send Braids to Aphetto, where she prepares for the Patriarch and becomes his second-in-command.
events.quote: was rewarded by becoming his second-in-command

events.summary: Braids hunts Kamahl with five serpent assassins, who slaughter many but are killed by barbarians.
events.quote: killed all five of her snakemen

events.summary: Braids zombifies Balthor in revenge for Leer and sets him against Laquatus before teleporting away.
events.quote: Braids then zombified Balthor in revenge for him killing Leer

events.summary: Braids, Traybor and Eesha reveal Laquatus's treachery and leave him alone in Krosa.
events.quote: leaving the merman alone in the forest

events.summary: Braids kills Seton and kidnaps Jeska for the Patriarch.
events.quote: She then killed the centaur and kidnapped Jeska

events.summary: Braids is injured commanding Cabal forces, used by Akroma, then serves Stonebrow before escaping to rejoin the Cabal.
events.quote: She eventually managed to escape and rejoin the Cabal.

events.summary: Braids helps Phage and Kuberr survive an assassination attempt and kills the Cabal Patriarch with a nightmare beast.
events.quote: she killed the Cabal Patriarch instead with one of her nightmare beasts

events.summary: During Karona's War Braids falls into fanaticism and is trapped in her own dementia space.
events.quote: ended up trapped in her own dementia space

events.summary: Cabal summoners drag Braids back from dementia space; she escapes split in two and allies with Shanna, Tiana and Rafwyn to kill her shard-self.
events.quote: Braids escaped from her dementia space during the second Phyrexian invasion, but split in two.

relations.quote: Braids was a powerful — and very mad — dementia caster for the Cabal on Dominaria .
was rewarded by becoming his second-in-command
She then killed the centaur and kidnapped Jeska
she killed the Cabal Patriarch instead with one of her nightmare beasts
she allied with Shanna Sisay , Tiana , and Rafwyn Capashen to kill her shard-self
